reason: Not paying upfront is the first thing that's made me look twice, but it's one guy in Kuwait with no reviews and two made-up demo sites. Last time I lost weeks chasing a designer, and the time and stress cost me as much as the money, so I'm not handing over my business to a stranger I can't meet this week.
objection: No reviews and no past clients I can actually check. If he goes quiet halfway or drags it out I'm stuck again, and he's thousands of miles away so there's nobody to chase.
would_change_my_mind: Speaking to a real client, even the Kuwait AC company, on a quick call or WhatsApp, plus a live site of theirs I can click through, and a fixed delivery date in writing.
